correctness.rationale: For all m,n>=3 and connected layers k<=m+n-3 (also k=m+n-2 when min(m,n)=3), visibility condition is (a<=1 or b<n) and (b<=1 or a<m). Feasible A-population levels form an interval. Every slide alters one selected status per side, giving max of the two partwise symmetric differences as lower bound. Correct cross-part wrong tokens directly while staying in interval, then relay each residual same-part swap in two slides via adjacent feasible level; attains bound. Sharp diameter for k<=N-3 is min(2k,2(N-k-1),max(m,n)); connected top layer has diameter 3. If m,n>=4 top layer has mn isolated configurations. Independent all-pairs BFS on K3,3 K3,4 K4,4 corroborated all layers and boundary.
